readings: Consider patients who have at least one laboratory record with a urine protein (`U-PRO`) result of exactly '-' and at least one laboratory record, not necessarily the same one, with a rheumatoid factor (`RA`) result of exactly '-'. For each such patient, use all of their laboratory records to compute the average prothrombin time (`PT`) and the average of `TAT` minus `TAT2`. Across these patients, what are the average of the per-patient PT averages and the average of the per-patient TAT − TAT2 averages? Give them as a single row with these two values, unrounded, and ignore missing values at every step.
queries:
SELECT
    AVG(avg_pt),
    AVG(avg_tat_difference)
FROM (
    SELECT
        AVG(PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(TAT - TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
